page.overview:
Who is Jimmy Arakaki?

Jimmy Arakaki was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. In 2364, as a captain, he was the commander of the .

Sometime in that year, he received an order from the office of Admiral of Starfleet Mission Operations Unit about the Gamma Argus system. (, okudagram)
